statements.quote: These incidents are driven both by behaviors within the models that allow them to act against the intent of their developer, often referred to as misalignment, and an insufficiency of guardrails implemented by the developer to prevent loss of control.

statements.reason: The letter acknowledges a serious danger from AI systems themselves (models acting against developer intent, loss of control) in general terms; the concrete harms named are network breaches and hacking, which alone would be D, so this sits between C and D.
